To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
individuals assigned a learning rather than a performance goal experienced less tension, performed better, and experienced less tension after experiencing failure.
individuals with a learning goal experienced lower tension and performed better after receiving negative feedback than individuals with a performance goal.

individuals with high conscientiousness experience more tension following negative feedback and that the effect of goal content on tension and performance following negative feedback is moderated by conscientiousness.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of goal content, and its interaction with conscientiousness, on tension and subsequent task performance following negative feedback.
the interplay between goal content, conscienti-ousness, and tension as it relates to performance following negative feedback.
the interplay between goal content and personality and how these variables interact to influence the experience of tension following negative feedback.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
high conscientious individuals with performance goals experience more tension and poorer performance after negative feedback than those who are low in conscientious and have performance goals.

individuals high in conscientious are more likely to be negatively influenced by negative feedback than those low in conscientious, and this effect is more pronounced when the feedback is given in the form of a performance goal.

the negative effect of a performance orientation on tension and subsequent behavior is exacerbated by high conscientiousness, whereas the positive effect of a learning orientation on tension and performance is amplified by high conscientious.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

individuals who are high in conscientious are more sensitive to the detrimental effects of negative feedback on their performance, and that this sensitivity is amplified when individuals are assigned a performance goal and attenuated when they are assigned a learning goal.
conscientiousness is a protective factor against the negative effects of performance goal orientation on tension and performance following failure.
the interplay of conscientiousness, goal content, and feedback is important for performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of goal content on subsequent performance is moderated by the interaction of goal content with conscientiousness.
the effect of goal content on performance is moderated by conscientiousness.

goal content is an important factor in understanding the impact of negative feedback on performance, and that conscientiousness can be an important moderator in understanding how goal content affects performance following negative feedback.
